description: Chunk, embed, and index a document into the workspace (dense + lexical lanes). Re-ingesting the same externalId replaces the prior version. Optional permissionSet gates who can retrieve it.

externalId.description: Stable id; re-ingesting it replaces the prior version.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata stored with each chunk.

permissionSet.description: Roles/users allowed to retrieve. Empty = anyone in the workspace.

source.description: Source label (filename, URL, system of origin).

name: ingest
